description: Get a Korean administrative rule in force. With only name: an outline (articles, annexes); with article: that article's text; with annex: the annex (별표; tables shown as text line by line). Filter a long annex with keyword or split it with page. article and annex cannot be combined. For a notice (고시) without articles, read the body by page (15,000 characters each) without annex.

keyword.description: Show only lines containing this Korean text (with 2 lines before and after). For an annex or the body of a notice without articles

name.description: Official Korean rule name. E.g. 소비자분쟁해결기준

page.description: Annex page (from 1). For a notice without articles, the body page, without annex

name: get_rule
title: Get administrative rule (행정규칙 보기)
